Container.Name: StreamLens
Container.Overview: StreamLens explains why a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby stream transcodes or buffers, and whose side the problem is on: the server, the network or the player. Open the WebUI, enter the setup code from the container log, create your admin account and connect your media server.
Container.ExtraParams: --init --user 0:0 --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add SETUID --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETPCAP --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --sysctl net.ipv4.ping_group_range="0 2147483647"

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, history and logs. Keep private.

Config.Name: Plex logs (optional)
Config.Description: Plex's Logs folder, read-only, for the Dolby Vision and CPU-fallback evidence. For linuxserver/plex: /mnt/user/appdata/plex/Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server/Logs

Config.Name: Media (optional)
Config.Description: Your media, read-only, for keyframe analysis. Say where Plex sees it in Media path map.

Config.Name: Media path map (optional)
Config.Description: Where Plex sees your media = where it is mounted here, for example /data/media=/media (several: separate with ;)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data folder (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data folder (100 = users)
